Our heroes visit a well defended island Outpost, equipped with strong AA turrets and also with a firewall defense that makes it impossible to hack the Command center.


== Tutorial ==
* The player is made familiar with the Firewall defense


== Objectives ==

# CONQUER THE OUTPOST
#* Conquer the island using your tactical and military skills.
# TAKE THE COMMAND CENTER
#* Hack the Command Center, which is protected externally by surrounding Firewalls.
# LOCATE THE FIREWALLS
#* Explore the island and find out where the Firewalls are located.
# OPEN THE GATE
#* Open the gate to gain access to the base with the Firewall.
# HACK THE NORTH FIREWALL
#* Disable the north Firewall preventing us from re-programming the Command Center.
# HACK THE SOUTH FIREWALL
#* Disable the south Firewall preventing us from re-programming the Command Center.


== Hints ==

'''Exploring the island''' in objective '''(#3)''' is best done with a Manta. It is better to fly it manually and keep low to better avoid enemy fire.

'''The controllers''' to open the gate in Objective '''(#4)''' are located on backsides of the buildings with tall antennas. The marker in the map does only show an approximate location, so it is necessary to find it first. <ref>http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?140810-Help-with-Outpost-mission-SPOILERS</ref>

'''The Command center''', objective '''(#2)''', is on the southwest of the island. It is important not to confuse it with Headquarters, which is a building on the southeast. The Headquarters cannot be interacted with in this mission. <ref>http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?140732-Campaign-mission-help-request-Outpost-*spoiler*</ref>
